name: Amazon.ca Rewards Mastercard

apr.notes: Rates shown on the MBNA page for the Ontario region; MBNA states that rates and fees may vary across regions.

credit_required.notes: Open to Canadian residents who are of the age of majority in their province or territory of residence.

base_rate.description: 1% back on eligible purchases everywhere else Mastercard is accepted.

categories.label: Amazon.ca and Whole Foods Market stores (eligible Prime members; 1.5% for non-Prime members)

rewards.redemption_notes: Use your rewards at Amazon.ca and apply rewards directly to eligible Amazon.ca items.

signup_bonus.description: 5% back at Amazon.ca, Whole Foods Market stores, grocery stores and restaurants for 6 months after approval, on the first $3,000 in eligible purchases.

notes: Earn rates differ for Prime and non-Prime members; Prime rates are shown in the categories. The insurance documents list Platinum and World Mastercard versions, so network_tier is none.
